title: Persona-Based Simulation Checks
description: AIL 606 textbook section on persona-based simulation checks: building constraint-driven personas (goal, constraint, context), driving them off the happy path until the prototype fails, verifying AI role-play findings, and converting failures into screen revisions.

learning_objectives.statement: Construct a persona from goal, constraint, and context, with no demographic filler
Predict which screen a given constraint will stress and drive the persona off the happy path until something fails
Treat AI persona role-play as hypotheses to verify against real settings or users, not as user data
Convert each observed failure into a specific screen revision or a justified decision to accept it

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
